plainTranslation: Wants and needs run as one instinct. The Sun person's drive and the Moon person's feelings fold together - you get each other at a level that's hard to explain. Strong foundational glue. Failure mode: coasting on the ease and never building anything with it. Use the natural understanding to make something; don't treat it as the whole relationship.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their identity sits right on your feelings, so who they are shapes your mood almost automatically.
summaryDeep: Their identity sits right on your feelings, so who they are shapes your mood almost automatically. It can feel like being deeply understood, and it can also mean their day sets yours. Keep your own emotional weather; let them warm it, not run it.
tension: The problem is that comfort can turn into dependence. One person may start expecting the other to always be their soft place to land, and the relationship can get a little too comfortable without anyone noticing.
advice: Enjoy the closeness, but don't disappear into it. This works best when both people still have their own life.
